text: {"name":"rf_irq_ready","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Checks an RF-related status and timing condition, conditionally clears hardware flags, updates shared timing state, and returns whether processing can proceed.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"status_bit","v1":"timing_context","v2":"timing_parameters","v3":"context_timestamp","v6":"shared_state"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":8,"meaning":"shared control/state value, written first as 0x40000 and then as 4"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"timestamp in the timing context"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"reference timestamp used for elapsed-time checks"},{"offset":48,"meaning":"shared timestamp updated from the timing context"}]}
